notes.title: The Year 2025 Update for Forklift 2024 - The Simulation is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Get ready to elevate your forklift experience! The Year 2025 Update is officially live and available as a free DLC for all players of Forklift 2024 - The Simulation! Packed with exciting new features and improvements, this update takes realism, visuals, and gameplay to the next level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972770/b94aa3e993f5ad38cfa853bfcead019e287d9e66.jpg[/img]

🆕 What’s New in the Year 2025 Update?
📦 Improved Forklift Controls
Enjoy smoother, more precise handling with refined controls designed for maximum realism.

📦 Enhanced Light and Shadow Rendering
Immerse yourself in stunning visuals with upgraded lighting and shadow effects.

📦 New Location: Harbor
Tackle fresh challenges in the bustling coastal setting of the new Harbor location, featuring narrow docks and unique layouts.

📦 Dynamic Weather Effects
Face ever-changing weather conditions like rain, fog, and clear skies, adding a new level of unpredictability to your workday.

📦 Overall Visual Quality Improvements
Experience detailed textures, polished environments, and a vibrant world brought to life with enhanced graphics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972770/7c9b7661a6aefdb7183df7b1ed94ae71a6065ec9.jpg[/img]

🎮 How to Get the Update
The Year 2025 Update DLC is available now for all owners of Forklift 2024 - The Simulation on Steam, Epic Games Store, and other PC platforms—completely free! We are still evaluating the possibility of bringing this update to PS4 and Nintendo Switch, so stay tuned for further announcements.

Thank you for your continued support, and we can’t wait to see you in the new Harbor location, lifting in style with enhanced controls and visuals! 🚛📦

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972770/207ea36b5dabf4e618697a17eb7ecfc5cd2f9761.jpg[/img]

👉 Download the Year 2025 Update now and experience the ultimate forklift simulation!

🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3385070/Forklift_2024__The_Simulation__Year_2025_Update/

Make sure to follow us on Steam for the latest updates and let us know what you think of the new improvements!

notes.title: Coming Soon: The Free Year 2025 Update DLC!
notes.notes:

[h2][b]What’s New in the Year 2025 Update?[/b][/h2]
📦 [b]Improved Forklift Controls[/b]

📦 [b]Enhanced Light and Shadow Rendering[/b]
